reg = yaml.safe_load(open('governance/check-registry.yaml'))['checks']
registered = set()
for c in reg:
    for tok in (c.get('cmd') or []):
        if isinstance(tok,str) and tok.endswith('.py'): registered.add(tok)

scripts = [str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('scripts').rglob('*.py')]
tools   = [str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('tools').rglob('*.py')]
allpy = scripts+tools

# what does anything reference?
blob = subprocess.run(['grep','-rIh','','--include=*.py','--include=*.yaml','--include=*.yml',
                       '--include=*.sh','--include=*.md','scripts','tools','governance','.github'],
                      capture_output=True,text=True).stdout

orphans=[]
for p in allpy:
    stem = pathlib.Path(p).stem
    if p in registered: continue
    # referenced by path or by module import?
    hits = blob.count(p) + len(re.findall(r'\b(?:import|from)\s+'+re.escape(stem)+r'\b', blob))
    if hits <= 1:   # only its own definition
        orphans.append((p, hits, sum(1 for _ in open(p,errors='replace'))))
print(f"UNREGISTERED + UNREFERENCED .py  ({len(orphans)}):")
for p,h,l in sorted(orphans, key=lambda x:-x[2]): print(f"   {l:5d} LOC  hits={h}  {p}")
print(f"\ntotal LOC in orphans: {sum(l for _,_,l in orphans)}")
